title.narrative: Corredores de Integracin Rehabilitacin y Mantenimiento Vial Fase I
Integration Corridors, Roads Rehabilitation and Maintenance Phase I

description.narrative: El fin del Programa es contribuir a mejorar la competitividad del sector producti-vo y la integracin econmica y social del Paraguay a travs de la pavimentacin, y rehabilitacin y mantenimiento de varios corredores principales de la red vial. El objetivo del Programa (propsito) es reducir los costos de transporte en los co-rredores de integracin nacional e internacional, a la vez que se conserva el patri-monio vial del pas. El Programa mejorar las condiciones de transitabilidad y los niveles de accesibilidad en sus respectivas reas de influencia, as como la seguri-dad vial y los tiempos de viaje en los tramos y circuitos a ser intervenidos.

The aim of the Program is to contribute to improve the competitiveness of the productive sector and the economic and social integration of Paraguay through the paving, rehabilitation and maintenance of several main corridors of the road network. The objective of the Program is to reduce the costs of transport in the national and interantional integration corridors, simultaneously the road patrimony of the country is being conserved. The Program will improve the conditions of transit and the levels of accessibility in its respective areas of influence, as well as road security and the times of trip in the sections and circuits to be taken part.
